---
title: "MINERVA Space Echo"
subtitle: "A tape echo whose tape is a memory"
toc: false
---

::: {.hero}
::: {.lead}
A Roland Space Echo has one tape loop. **MINERVA Space Echo** stores every bar you play as a separate
memory *trace*, and plays back an **echo**: a blend of all the traces, each weighted by how much it
resembles what you are playing now.
:::
:::

![The plug-in window: each row of the memory matrix is one stored bar.](images/screenshot.png){fig-alt="The plug-in window, with the memory matrix at the top left, the Heard and Echo spectrograms at the top right, and tabbed parameter pages below."}

It is an audio effect (AU and VST3 for macOS, aimed at Ableton Live) built on **MINERVA II**, Douglas
Hintzman's multiple-trace model of human memory. With the memory set to a single trace it is exactly a
1-bar tape delay. Give it a hundred traces and it starts answering you with *earlier* bars that sound
like this one: a delay with déjà vu.

## What it can do

- **Remember and recall.** Up to 4000 traces, from 10 ms grains to 4-bar phrases, tempo-synced or free.
- **Choose what to keep.** Freeze memory, gate what gets stored, clamp (lock) traces so they're never
  replaced, merge similar bars into prototypes, or let memory fade and forget.
- **Cue it live.** Recall by the last bar, as each bar unfolds, or continuously with no bar grid.
- **Be a Space Echo.** Three playback heads with an RE-201-style mode selector, wow and flutter, tape
  drive, hiss, feedback EQ and a spring reverb.
- **Blend spectrally.** Mix memories as spectra so they don't cancel, time-stretch old traces, freeze
  the echo into a drone.
- **Show its work.** A live view of the memory matrix: every trace's address, its activation, and which
  heads are playing it.
- **Seed it.** Drop audio files in to fill memory; save and reload memories as plain WAV + JSON folders.
- **Play it.** Presets, MIDI note control and automatable actions.

::: {.callout-warning}
## Version 0.1.0
Every stage of the [build plan](https://github.com/CrumpLab/MinervaSpaceEcho/blob/HEAD/plan.md) is in place and
the plug-in passes Apple's `auval` and `pluginval`, but it has not yet been played much in Live. Expect rough
edges and please [report problems](https://github.com/CrumpLab/MinervaSpaceEcho/issues).
:::
